name: Amsterdam
summary: Amsterdam combines historic canals, one of the best cycling infrastructures in the world and a world-class tech and startup scene in the heart of Europe. As an EU citizen, settling and working there is as simple as changing cities within Spain: without visas or special paperwork. English is spoken virtually everywhere, making daily life and working with international clients easier.
